I've now walked through the empty states, the large-collection behavior, and the tricky saving situations, so the flows feel well settled. Before I propose we start building the real thing, one important behavior question — in everyday terms, not technical:

**When you save a link on your computer and later open the app on your phone, do you expect to see that same link there — i.e. one shared collection that follows you across devices? Or would you be fine with each device keeping its own separate set of bookmarks?**

The reason I ask: "one collection everywhere" means the app needs to remember your bookmarks centrally (and likely sign you in), whereas "per-device" is simpler and keeps everything on the device you saved it on. This choice shapes what "finished" means for this first build, so I'd rather get your intent than assume.

(Either way, I'll make sure your bookmarks are still there when you come back to the app — this question is specifically about whether they're *shared between your devices*.)
